lyrics:
The soft-shoe team sent a laugh across the hall,
The tapping shoes answered from the touring train;
Through the hours they carried delight,
And made a song from all that brought them there.

Chorus:
Raise the curtain, let the whole room sing,
Carry “Painted Footlight of the Palace Stage” wherever voices go;
Let every listening neighbor take a part,
And keep its honest measure in the heart.

A bright-eyed juggler waited smiling in the wings,
The orchestra bell traveled past the center boards;
No one there would trade away patience,
For every careful voice had something true to share.

When evening settled over the lamplit lobby,
The balcony crowd found one more trick to show;
They left behind a little courage,
A tune for any traveler passing there.

Chorus:
Raise the curtain, let the whole room sing,
Carry “Painted Footlight of the Palace Stage” wherever voices go;
Let every listening neighbor take a part,
And keep its honest measure in the heart.
